title: Vegan Egyptian Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with garlic and egyptian spices, perfect for a vegan dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of water in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the stew, zesty, and chewy to the pot.
Pour in the remaining 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with additional zesty to taste.
Optional: serve with a side of steamed egyptian vegetables.
